ui.0_9_vites_sec_x_range: 0-9: Select Gear    X: Range    H: Horn
ui.25dk_odak_seansi_baslat_filo_daha: Start a 25-min focus session: your fleet burns less fuel and earns a cash bonus when it ends
ui.a_otomatik_hareket_ac_kapa_g: A: Toggle Auto-Move    G: Hide Entire UI
ui.akilli_ai_q_learning_ac_kapat: Toggle Smart AI (Q-learning) (B) - the vehicle learns to find its way during cargo/target deliveries
ui.arac_govdesinde_kirlilik_arttikca_cam: Show/hide mud stains on the body as the vehicle gets dirtier
ui.araclara_ekstra_davranislar_ozellikle: Adds extra behaviours and features to your vehicles. More coming later.
ui.araclarin_ne_hizda_kirlenecegini_olce: Scales how quickly vehicles get dirty (0 = never)
ui.araclarin_ne_hizda_yakit_tuketecegini: Scales how quickly vehicles burn fuel (0 = never)
ui.arayuz_dilini_degistir: Change the interface language - applied instantly
ui.bidonu_al_bir_araca_tikla_iptal: Pick up the can and click a vehicle - press Esc to cancel
ui.bir_araci_ekledikten_sonra_secili_ara: Once you have added a vehicle, attach one from the 'Trailer / Equipment' section of the SELECTED VEHICLE panel.
ui.ctrls_kaydet_l_yukle_e_eklentiler: Ctrl+S: Save    L: Load    E: Add-ons
ui.dusuk_aralik_yari_hiz_ama_cok: Low Range: half speed but far more pulling power (X)
ui.filo_verisini_arac_sayisi_para_mesafe: Publishes fleet data (vehicle count, money, distance) to your own MQTT broker.
ui.gorsel_bir_olay_gercek_geri_donusum: A purely visual event - it does not touch your real Recycle Bin
ui.iot_broker_ipucu: Broker address. Without a port, 8883 is used when TLS is on and 1883 when it is off.
ui.iot_kullanici_adi_ipucu: Fill in if your broker requires authentication; leave empty to connect anonymously.
ui.iot_parola_ipucu: The password is never written to disk; it is used for this session only.
ui.iot_sertifika_ipucu: Only for your own broker with a self-signed certificate. When enabled, the connection is not protected against man-in-the-middle attacks.
ui.iot_tls_ipucu: Encrypts the connection with TLS (MQTTS). Keep it on if you use credentials.
ui.kendi_arac_gorselini_beyaz_arkaplanli: Import your own vehicle image (on a white background)
ui.kis_temali_hava_durumu_yagmurla_ayni: Winter-themed weather - cannot run at the same time as rain
ui.klavye_kisayollari_acik_yazarken_kapa: Keyboard Shortcuts: On (click to turn off while typing)
ui.motor_korna_carpisma_gibi_efektler: Level for effects such as engine, horn and collisions
ui.p_duraklat_w_basilisurt_arac_yika: P: Pause    W (hold + drag): Wash Vehicle
ui.panelden_ayir_bagimsiz_pencereye_cika: Detach Panel (move to its own window)
ui.q_secili_araci_imlece_cagir: Q: Summon Selected Vehicle to Cursor
ui.r_arac_ekle_c_temizle_delete: R: Add Vehicle    C: Clear    Delete: Remove Selected
ui.shiftsurukle_arac_seciliyken_rota_ciz: Shift+Drag (with a vehicle selected): Draw a route
ui.shifttik_secili_arac_lar_a_rota: Shift+Click: Assign a route/target to the selected vehicle(s)
ui.surus_modunu_ac_kapat_bosluk_wasd: Toggle Drive Mode (Space) - control with WASD/Arrow keys
ui.suruste_0_9_vites_sec_x: While driving 0-9: Select Gear, X: Range
ui.suruste_wasd_ok_tuslari_sur_fren: While driving WASD / Arrow Keys: Drive, Brake
ui.t_tema_degistir_m_ses_ac: T: Change Theme    M: Toggle Sound
ui.v_ucus_modu_secili_arac_k: V: Flight Mode (selected vehicle)    K: Lock/Unlock
ui.yakinina_gelen_araclari_otomatik_yaki: Automatically refuels and repairs vehicles that come near it
ui.yazi_yarisi_baslat_ne_kadar_hizli: Start a typing race: the faster you type, the faster your vehicle goes
ui.yolu_keser_bakimi_dusuk_hp_lt: Blocks the road and fines poorly maintained vehicles (HP<50%)
